gbm_population_evidence.quote: Grade III or Grade IV Glioma
Histological diagnosis of primary WHO grade III or IV glioma

gbm_population_flag.reason: Glioblastoma is not named in conditions/title/inclusion; only 'grade IV glioma' without IDH requirement, which D27C treats as historical glioblastoma. Could alternatively be high_grade_glioma_unspecified.

candidate_evidence.quote: Single intravenous administration of 18F fluciclovine for PET Scan

This study will examine whether positron emission tomography (PET) imaging with fluciclovine can reliably differentiate true progression from pseudoprogression months earlier than the conventional MRI methods.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Enlarging or new contrast-enhancing mass suspicious for progression/recurrence (at least 10mm in one direction)

role_evidence.quote: PET with 18F fluciclovine injection, 185 MBq (5 mCi) ± 20%, delivered as an intravenous bolus

agents.drug_class_hint: 18F-labelled amino acid analogue PET tracer (Axumin), diagnostic imaging only

coder_notes: Diagnostic imaging study only (18F-fluciclovine PET for progression vs pseudoprogression); no therapeutic agent. Population is WHO grade III or IV glioma; glioblastoma is named only in the detailed description. Coded mixed_glioma_gbm_named on the basis that 'grade IV glioma' without IDH requirement = historical glioblastoma (D27C), flagged uncertain. Fails S6 either way. Phase registered as PHASE3.
